name: Ephesians : From Death to Life

provenance.detail: Church playlist Ephesians : From Death to Life (PLSDa13_3L-B0AHyIufORH_VqT-_BC2v3z).

description: A twelve-week, verse-by-verse study of Paul’s letter to the Ephesians: our riches in Christ in the first half and our responsibilities in the second.
note: Josh launches the letter as a twelve-week, verse-by-verse series.

provenance.detail: The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes Predestined for Praise.
Josh says, “Today, we’re going to launch a series examining Paul’s letter to the church in Ephesus.”
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes Selfless Prayers.
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes His Great Love.
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes Peacemaker.
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes The Unveiling.
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes He Is Able.
Josh preaches Ephesians 4:1–16 and says, “I told you this day was coming in this series.”
Josh says, “We’ve been going through Ephesians and today we land in chapter 4:17.”
The official Ephesians : From Death to Life playlist includes Make Every Day Sunday!.
